title: Ik Zainab Te, Haye Dard Hazaraan
body:
Ik Zainab Te, Haye Dard Hazaraan.
Ali Di Jaye Nu, Mar Mukhaya Aye, Bazaraan Te Darbaraan.
<<DIVIDER>>
1- Veer Izataan Walay, Gaye Ban Wich Maray, Maan Muk Gaye Saray
Bhirawaan de Zainab, Sangaan Te sir waikhay, Tay Labdhi Aye Dastaraan
<<DIVIDER>>
2- Jadoon Zainab Guzari, Sham Bazar Wichon, Kuj Shami Bole
Aye Kiwein Ho Gayi Aye, Qaidi Kithe Gaye Ne, Iss Bhain De Veer Atharaan
<<DIVIDER>>
3- Shoor Galiyaan Chay Hoya, Zahra Jaiyaan Nou Ewein, Aa Ke Pathar Maro
Bhira De Lashay Tay, Zakhm Jiwein Laye, Nou Lakh Teeraan Talwaraan
<<DIVIDER>>
4- Sham Zindan Andar, Kaya Abid Nu Phuphi, Meri Qaidaan Te Na Ro
Main Razi Haan Abid, Parda Tay Keeta Aye, Zindan Diyaan Dewaraan
<<DIVIDER>>
5- Ayho Fizza Sochay, Ayho Sheerein Aakhay, Ayho Hind Wain Kare
Kiyon Wasaye Nay, Sham Walay Zindaan, Haye Janat De Sardaraan
<<DIVIDER>>
6- Ghairtaan Di Khaliq, Bint-e-Zahra Da Sada, Shukr SAQLAIN Karo
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Sadqa Zainab Da, Baqi Jahan Tay, Dhiyaan Aye Parday Daraan
